changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE email_schedule ADD CONSTRAINT email_schedule_report_type_check CHECK (report_type::text = ANY (ARRAY[ 'DASHBOARD_STATISTICS'::character varying, 'DISCOUNTS_OFFERS'::character varying, 'DISCOUNTS_PROMOTIONS'::character varying, 'ITEMIZED_SALES'::character varying, 'TABLE_WISE_SALES'::character varying, 'PAYMENT_TYPES_BREAKDOWN'::character varying, 'DAILY_SALES_SUMMARY'::character varying, 'TRANSACTIONS'::character varying, 'ORDERS'::character varying, 'SALES'::character varying, 'SALES_AND_REVENUE'::character varying, 'PAYMENT_AND_FINANCIAL'::character varying, 'MENU_PERFORMANCE'::character varying, 'EMPLOYEE_PERFORMANCE'::character varying, 'STAFF_PERFORMANCE'::character varying ]::text[]));
